paragraphs: Chapter 1054
Episode 251. The Great Adversaries (4)
Even after Orgal left, his colleagues remained deep in thought for a while.

Too much had changed in an instant. Shocking truths were revealed, Kinzelo, once a target for extermination, became an ally, and the power of Ziffle that the Alliance had recognized so far was just the tip of the iceberg.
Especially for the five people who had seen their own counterparts in the multiverse, the situation was even more complicated. Even Sandra stopped her rampage and was organizing her thoughts.
"...For now, I must report this to the butler."
"I will convey the details to the Alliance, including the Ice Castle."
Mary and Kasimir picked up their communicators. There would be significant repercussions throughout the Alliance.

"Hmm, the way things are turning out is extraordinary. If what Orgal said is all true, then those Demon Lords can attack us anytime, right? That is, if they overcome the constraints of interfering between worlds."
"That seems likely, Murakan friend."
"It's quite surreal, isn't it? With the current power of the Alliance, it feels like we could take on anything that comes our way."
"...If I were a Ziffle who could interfere with other dimensions."
As Jin spoke, all eyes turned to him.
"I would be preparing for an all-out war. I've settled all other worlds, and this is the only one left."
Once this world is finished, Ziffle will become the only winner across all dimensions.
With their goal in sight, there was no reason for them not to exert all their efforts.

"Right now, they say there are constraints, but they can observe us, and we can't observe them. That alone shows that the so-called constraints are already breaking. They have already won in numerous worlds. We're stronger than ever, but they are probably much stronger than that."
Facing a single dimension is one thing, but a 'Dimensional Alliance' or a 'Unified Ziffle' is an entirely different force that can't be beaten in a straightforward confrontation.
"...Therefore, we must swiftly and decisively end Ziffle. Before they receive support from other worlds."
"Even if we end them, couldn't another Ziffle invade us?"

"That's entirely possible. But let's think about that when it comes to it. First, we need to extinguish the fire at our feet. For now, Brother Ban, as soon as the Golden Fleet returns, start tracking the Tower of Story. Luet the Housekeeper of Runkandel will join you."
Luet is currently managing the internal affairs of Runkandel.
However, it was time for her, like Valeria, to get into the field and leave the tasks to Petro. After all, she too was a record ability holder.
"Understood."

"Now that Kinzelo has tentatively become an ally, we will significantly reduce the forces invested in homeland defense. Given the current situation, it's unlikely that Ziffle will invade us immediately. Above all, if they too recognize the existence of beings from other dimensions, they would prioritize holding out until support arrives."
"That's a valid point. It will be a battle of endurance. Excluding the manipulation by the Origin Stone, we are overwhelmingly superior in terms of power."
The Tower of Story is currently presumed to be mobile like a flying fortress.
Moreover, the constant manipulation by the Origin Stone near the Tower makes it optimally defensive, as it can't be traced by records.
"Murakan, Luna, and other superhumans, including myself, will also track the Tower of Story in a way that doesn't overlap with the Golden Fleet."

The long-cherished 'Golden Fleet' of the Barmel Alliance has now entered full-scale production, thanks to the liberation of Laprarosa and the overcoming of most technical issues. Thus, all superhumans were planning to board the Golden Fleet to track the Tower.
"The formation of the fleet commanders will be handled by Brother Ban and the Battle Kings. And to counter manipulation, tracking will always be conducted with a Genesis or a record ability holder."

The 'power of existence' possessed by Genesis, and record magic. The former may be somewhat inferior to the latter, but it can still prevent historical manipulation to some extent. No matter how many Golden Fleets there are, one of the two is always necessary.

"While focusing on defense, they will still try to demonstrate their dignity to the public in some way. Therefore, suppressing and preventing the emergence of forces that sympathize with Ziffle's power, like in the past, will be your responsibility, Quikantel. The forces will be provided by Runkandel and Tikan."
"Got it. Indeed, there are many fools around."
"And tracking Ganesto must proceed in parallel while searching for the Tower of Story. Thinking about it, I should ask Orgal if we can use the dream ability for this purpose. And Jet."
"Yes, my lord!"
"Contact the Demonic Realm immediately and arrange a meeting with Silkiya."
Silkiya Arcia.
Jin was thinking about her existence. In the Demonic Realm, she had saved the most people and possessed the most powerful 'mass dimensional transfer' ability in this world.

- Silkiya has more abilities. Lord Basset said that even she hasn't fully awakened to her power yet. So after some time, when we need her power, contact us anytime. Or maybe Silkiya will contact us first?
Basset, in his lifetime, described Silkiya as a being that could become a god, and her dimensional transfer ability was already divine in itself.
Jin thought that perhaps her power could be the key to facing Ziffle.
A dimensional gate that can penetrate Ziffle's manipulation and advance to the Tower of Story, or a passage that can interfere with other dimensions.

Of course, there's no guarantee that Silkiya can necessarily accomplish such a feat, but if there's even a small possibility, it's time to explore it. Even if it's not those two things, Silkiya's powers could be used in various ways.
The Demonic Realm also needed a thorough reexamination in many ways.

During the two months since its liberation from Zito, the Demonic Realm had been pouring all its efforts into reconstruction. The 'Flames of Destruction' left by Kelliark had almost disappeared, so there was one more important task to undertake in addition to reconstruction.

Finding the remaining altars of the Sun God in the Demonic Realm. If it was an avatar of Kinselo that wanted 'maintenance', it would become a strong ally. If the opposite, like Bligiet, it had to be extinguished before resurrection.
"Understood!"
Besides meeting Silkiya, Valeria was the most crucial for all other tasks, as Orgal had said.
"That's all for today. However, as an emergency situation can arise at any time, please be extra careful, everyone."
Jin then left the meeting room to meet Valeria.
'She'll be in the hangar, in the Red Owl, sorting out her thoughts.'
Like everyone else, Jin's mind was heavy too.
Regression.
While heading to the hangar, Jin thought about regression. He felt that it was time to reveal to his colleagues that he was a regressor.
'As a child, I had no power to reveal it. There was no reason to. After gaining power, I couldn't explain it. And now...'
Now, there was no reason not to say it.
His colleagues in the Alliance wouldn't blame or shun him for being a regressor. But for the countless ordinary people whose lives changed due to Jin's regression...
Not all of them could support Jin.
'The world is not yet better than before my regression, and someone has surely become unhappy because of it.'
The only one who ever acknowledged this guilt was Ayulra, just before she vanished.

- The deaths on your path are not your responsibility, but that of the being who made you that way. However, when you reach the end of that path... Maybe you won't be overwhelmed by so many deaths. There must be a reason why you gained the power of regeneration as soon as you became Genesis.
Ayulra's words were comforting, but they hadn't yet become a reality.
'Regeneration power... Can this power truly reverse all the misfortunes they experienced?'
Impossible.
That's what he always thought. That's why he, as a regressor, had to make the world a place worth living in.
Jin's current inclination to reveal his regression stemmed from this context. Just as he was exploring Silkiya's power, perhaps his regression held some key to breaking through the situation.

He wasn't afraid of being pointed fingers at. Even if his colleagues were disappointed to learn that he was a regressor, it was the same. The only fear was that his regression would make the world more painful.
"Valeria."
Jin opened the door to the Red Owl. As expected, Valeria was curled up in the cockpit.
"Are you here?"
The two gazed at each other for a while.
"What I said in the meeting room earlier, I wasn't trying to get a particular answer from you. You know that, right?"
"I know. It's just..."
"You want to talk about your secret?"
Jin's eyes widened.

Valeria was recalling the day they met on Honka Island. That day, Jin practically revealed the existence of a 'secret,' and Valeria deliberately chose not to hear it. It felt wrong to do so, as if guided by intuition.
"Right."
Just as Jin was about to continue, Valeria shook her head, stopping him.
"Do
n't do it."
"Huh?"
"I'm incredibly curious, but it feels like it shouldn't be said right now, for a very practical reason."
"Practical reason?"
Valeria stood up and approached Jin.
"Honestly, I've started to guess what your secret is. I've had a few personal experiences that you don't know about, and the information Orgal brought was the final piece."
Personal experiences referred to the strange events Valeria experienced with Jin, like when he ordered the same food in the restaurant that Valeria from a previous life liked.
"So why..."

"I think your secret is the most important factor in this situation. Maybe even more important than meetings with Orgal or Helluram. And Orgal said their meeting would be recorded in the completed Origin Stones of other dimensions. So, Ziffle would become aware of their meeting."
Valeria was cautious.
The moment Jin confesses his secret, the completed Origin Stones of other dimensions would record it.

"Of course, the completed Origin Stones can't record everything in this world. There are constraints. But they're likely to capture the most important facts, like Orgal and Helluram's meeting... or your secret. Therefore, if your secret is revealed, we might lose a crucial variable. That's why I said you absolutely shouldn't say it, under any circumstances."
